{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent true outcomes show persistent mean reversion toward lower levels after high peaks.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history includes multiple negative entries (e.g., >2 consecutive negative sentiment values).",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5–10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a downtrend, slightly increase forecast to reflect potential rebound, but avoid overcorrection beyond 10% above recent low.",
    "If model consistently overpredicts early in the 30-day horizon, apply a 3–5% downward adjustment to the first 5–7 days of forecast.",
    "For sentiment history with a single negative entry, reduce forecast peak by 5–8% to reflect cautionary market behavior."
  ]
}
